name: Blue Hawaiian
summary: **Blue Hawaiian** is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] from [[breeder:CalCo Genetics]], crossing [[kona-sunset|Kona Sunset]] and [[blueberry-syrup|Blueberry Syrup]]. Kona Sunset traces to 1980s Hawaiian Kona genetics crossed with Dark Cross, while Blueberry Syrup combines DJ Short's [[blueberry|Blueberry]] line with Humble Pie.
